faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: Everything owners usually ask before flipping the switch.

q1.a: Eve is an AI receptionist for spas, clinics, and salons. Clients message, Eve checks your real calendar, and books the appointment — while you're with another client.

q2.a: No. Open slots come from your connected calendar. If it’s not free there, Eve won’t offer it.

q3.q: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q3.a: No. Start a free trial, connect your calendar, and start booking from your own workspace page — no credit card needed.

q4.a: Yes. Guests pick EN or VI on the public booking page. Your dashboard language is separate.

q5.a: WhatsApp and voice are on the roadmap for Premium and Enterprise. Web chat and calendar booking are available today.

q6.q: Who owns the calendar and data?
q6.a: You do. Eve books into your own calendar and keeps each business's data separate.
